name: Facet
text: Choose a high-contrast dark theme by default, with a manual light-mode toggle. This maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain in low light—matching Manus’s competitive analysis and Graphify’s proven success. The trade-off is that light-mode users must manually switch, but system preference defaults cover most cases, keeping the majority satisfied without clutter.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode if it’s the default, even if they prefer light mode in some contexts. A better alternative is to respect system preference by default but let users override it permanently. Settle it with A/B testing: measure engagement drop when light-mode users are forced into dark mode by default.
